notes.title: Season 26: Laser Bugs!
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWENTY SIX: LASER BUGS!![/b][/u]

New Season, NEW WEAPON!!!

It's been a while since we shook things up with a new weapon, and this one is a real straight-shooter.
Introducing [b]"The Laser"[/b]. This new weapon charges briefly, and fires a white hot beam of...something deadly, straight and fast. Expect a direct hit to take out your average enemy. Learn to use this weapon well, and it could be a game-changer!

We are also introducing a NEW RANKED MODE: DUOS! Team up with your fiercest ally and climb the leaderboards!  Earn trophies and bragging rights for performing well as a team!

Other Enhancements:
• New Map: The Grove
• A new batch of "insect-tech" themed skins. 

There may also be another special, secret treat for dedicated players to find this season.... Who will find it first?? 

Let those lasers fly!!!
-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 25: Pumpkin Smash
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWENTY FIVE: PUMPKIN SMASH!![/b][/u]

New Season, Theme & Competitive Squads Mode!

Spooky Season is back, and with it comes a much hyped, much requested feature: Ranked Squads! We've poked and prodded to try and resolve the issue of teamers working together to climb the leaderboards for a few seasons now. This season, we've decided to encourage and require players to team up and work together to earn trophies. Scoring is still calculated individually based on performance.

Other Enhancements:
• New Map: Pumpkin Patch
• A new batch of spooky themed Skins: Candy, Ghost and evolvable Bat in the Season Pass along with new pumpkin themed Trail and Parachute.

There may also be a special, secret treat for dedicated players to find this season.... Who will find it first?? 

Be safe out there!
-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 24: Flak to School
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWENTY FOUR: FLAK TO SCHOOL!![/b][/u]

New Season and Theme:

After taking some well-deserved summer holidays, the team is back with a new season of content! This time we're going back to school! Yay! If there's one thing everyone loves, it's school! That's why we've cooked up some scholarly tanks and what-nots for season 24! 

We are working on some new game modes and plan on creating a new competitive mode which should put to rest the boosting issue once and for all!! Stay tuned....

Other Enhancements:
• NEW: Custom Tank as decided by the COMMUNITY! - Robo-Spider
• NEW: School themed Skins (Bus, Pencil, Eraser)

Also, keep your eye out for our new MOD TANK, given out to the hardest working mod team on Discord! Behave yourself when you spot one. They can and will drop the BAN HAMMER!!!

See you out there!
-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 22: Deep Sea Destruction
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWENTY TWO: DEEP SEA DESTRUCTION!![/b][/u]

New Season and Theme:

Welcome to the Deep Sea Destruction season! Dive into an oceanic adventure, featuring underwater themed tank, mythical creatures, and intense battles!  🚀🌊

New Tanks:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1104059990299377765/1124431750806900766/image.png?width=1910&height=468[/img]

We've made additional tweaks to try and limit boosting in the game, ensuring fair and competitive gameplay for all players. Let's keep the battles skill-based and balanced!

Introducing the new "Hit!" indicator! Now, even when your attacks land off-screen, you'll receive a visual indicator, providing instant feedback when your shots successfully connect.

Other Enhancements:

• Enjoy optimized matchmaking, ensuring faster and smoother game sessions.
• Various bug fixes and performance optimizations for an enhanced gaming experience.
• NEW: Custom Tank designed by Promethium - Season 20 Winner
• NEW: Deep Sea skins (Clam, Starfish, Jellyfish and Sub)

Prepare to plunge into the depths of the Deep Sea Destruction season, command powerful tanks, and dominate the underwater battlegrounds of Rocket Bot Royale! 🌊🤖 #RocketBotRoyale #DeepSeaDestruction #NewSeason

And as we do every Season, we will be awarding a FULLY CUSTOMIZED TANK to the Season Winner, designed to their specifications by our tank designer, so jump into the new RANKED ROYALE MODE, and battle your way to the top of the Trophy pile! 
 
-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 20: Cake by the Ocean
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWENTY: CAKE by the OCEAN!![/b][/u]

HAPPY BIRTHDAY Rocket Bot Royalers!

We are thrilled to announce the 20th season of Rocket Bot Royale - "Cake by the Ocean", a celebration of 1 full year of RBR! 

This season introduces a brand [b]new game mode[/b] that the community has been eagerly anticipating - "Ranked Royale". This mode is a 4-player battle royale that takes place on smaller maps and is now the only mode where players can earn trophies. This mode will provide a more competitive and challenging experience for the players who want it, while also being a better reflection of their skills. Don't worry though, the classic 25 player Battle Royale is still around, and where you earn points to progress through the season, just without the pressure of losing your precious trophies! 

In addition to the new game mode, the season pass offers players the chance to earn new cake-themed tanks and other birthday-related cosmetics. These include new Cake tanks, Candle Trail and Crown Parachute, that will make your tank look deliciously sweet and unique on the battlefield. 

We hope you enjoy the new season of Rocket Bot Royale and the new game mode "Ranked Royale", and thanks for a great first year! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield, and wish you the best of luck in your quest to become the next "Tank King"!

[b]SEASON 20 UPDATE NOTES:[/b]
New mode, new content, better balance.

NEW: Ranked Royale
- 4 player competitive free-for-all with several new maps 
RETURNING: Unranked Battle Royale
- 25 players in a classic Battle Royale
RETURNING: Squads Royale
- Team up with your friends

NEW: Custom Tank designed by BingoBoingo - Season 18 Winner

Minor changes:
- Shield pushes enemies away from where it's deployed
- Shield no longer blocks damage - it only deflects missiles
- Rapid fire cooldown increased
- Jetpack nerfed
- Faster app load time

And remember, ONCE AGAIN, we will be awarding a FULLY CUSTOMIZED TANK to the Season Winner, designed to their specifications by our tank designer, so jump into the new RANKED ROYALE MODE, and battle your way to the top of the Trophy pile! 
 
-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 19: RISE OF THE BOTS
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON NINETEEN: Rise of the BOTS!![/b][/u]

Hello Rocket Bot Royalers!

We are excited to announce the upcoming season "Rise of the Bots" for Rocket Bot Royale. This season introduces three NEW ENEMY TANK TYPES: Mine-Bot, Brain-Bot, and Heavy-Bot. Each of these bots presents a unique challenge and will require players to adapt their tactics to overcome them.

The Mine-Bot is an explosive enemy that can't shoot, but will track you down if you are in range. This bot presents a unique challenge to players as it requires them to be cautious and aware of their surroundings, or risk taking heavy damage.

The Brain-Bot uses the newest AI technology to fight better than any other bot in the game. Its advanced programming allows it to predict player movements and fire accurately, making it a formidable foe for even the most experienced players.

The Heavy-Bot has more hit points and is harder to kill than any other bot in the game. Its durability and power make it a formidable opponent that players may need to work together to take down.

In addition to these new bots, the Season Pass offers players the chance to earn new ENEMY-THEMED tanks and cosmetics. Thanks to your efforts, we have destroyed and dismantled enough enemy bots to reverse engineer and create our own tanks using enemy parts and tech. 

We hope you enjoy the new season of Rocket Bot Royale and look forward to seeing you on the battlefield. Good luck against the NEW ENEMY BOTS, and have fun out there! 

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes
• ☠️ Enemy Tank themed season pass!
• 💣 New Enemy Base themed level!

And remember, ONCE AGAIN, we will be awarding a FULLY CUSTOMIZED TANK to the Season Winner, designed to their specifications by our tank designer, so jump on the leaderboard and battle your way to the top of the Trophy pile! 

-Team RBR

notes.content:

Hope you enjoy the new update and the new Season, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Win a PERSONALIZED CUSTOM TANK design in Spooky Season 13 of RBR!
notes.content:
Join us for Season 13 of Rocket Bot Royale to collect the full set of spooky Tanks and cosmetics we've added! We've been waiting for the fall season to showcase the first batch of creepy skins. (Granted, the spider from Season 9-Deep Woods was pretty creepy!)

Additionally, for the first time, we are also giving the winner of Season 13 the chance to work with our designer to create a PERSONALIZED TANK SKIN as a way to show off a hard-earned season victory!

[b]Become a permanent part of Rocket Bot Royale history![/b]
Compete in Season 13 to claim the top spot on the Trophy Leaderboard, and get the chance to create your own personalized Tank skin, with help from our designer, that will be added to the game as a Legendary Skin, with your name and accomplishment attached! The Season runs from Friday September 23 - November 1st. 

Good luck, and see you on the island!
Join us on Discord to join the community!

notes.title: Season 12: FRIGID WATERS
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON TWELVE: FRIGID WATERS![/b][/u]

Season 12 of Rocket Bot Royale is here!! We've enjoyed watching the competition heat up with the addition of the new Trophy System, and are excited to see who captures that top spot this Season! 

We've added a detailed post-game breakdown of the Trophy distribution since it can seem a bit random at times. Hopefully this will de-mystify things a bit! Just click the (?) below the Trophies on the Results screen.

[b]SEASON PASS:
[/b]Dip your toes in the FRIGID WATERS of Season 12! We've added some cool new cosmetics to counteract the summer heat we've been having. 

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes
• 🥶 Ice themed season pass!
• ❄️ ice theme level!
• 🏆 Compete against your friends with the friends-only leaderboard view
• 🔭 option on mobile to increase view area

notes.title: Season 11: MARS ATTACKS introduces Skill Based Leaderboards!
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON ELEVEN: MARS ATTACKS![/b][/u]

Season 11 of Rocket Bot Royale brings some BIG changes, the biggest being a new Leaderboard ranking system! We've introduced a new Trophy system which rewards you with trophies when you outperform your opponents, and removes them when you get outplayed(Solo mode only). 

No longer is the leaderboard dominated by players who can play the most games. The most skilled players will now rise to the top. 

Additionally, we've created Reward Tiers based on your rank at the end of the season. Climb the leaderboard to earn HUGE rewards!! Here's what else is new in this update:

[b]SEASON PASS:
[/b]Voyage to Mars in the new Season Pass which includes space themed cosmetics earn-able throughout the season, as well as 3 new Mars themed levels!

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 🗓 Seasons are now 1 month long
• 👀 View your position on leaderboard (not just top 50)
• 💎 Reward Tiers based on trophies collected
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes

Hope you enjoy the new update and the new Season! 

-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 9: DEEP WOODS introduces Another New Powerup: Poison Cloud!
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON NINE: DEEP WOODS![/b][/u]

Season 9 of Rocket Bot Royale brings yet ANOTHER NEW POWER-UP: POISON CLOUD! Launch a bottle of poisonous liquid which explodes in a large noxious cloud that damages all tanks within it, including yourself, so be careful with this one! Here's what else is new in this update:

[b]POISON CLOUD:
[/b] A new area-of-effect weapon that can really turn the tables on your opponents. Launch the Poison at an opponent to force them to move to a different location or suffer massive damage. Be careful not to drop one at your own feet as this poison damages All tanks within its radius.

[b]SEASON PASS:
[/b]Enter the Deep Woods and encounter some new crawly critters and some more organic cosmetics. A new WOODS level is now in the mix as well. 

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 💎 Buy skins and stuff directly for GEMS!
• 🌊 New Lake level
• 🎁 Now receive 1xp for every kill in public matches.
• ⛑ Health perk is split into two! Now +20% for 2 energy, and you can take 2!
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes to Custom Lobbies.

Hope you enjoy the new update and the new Season! 

-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 8: BEACH BLAST introduces New Powerup: The Jetpack!
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON EIGHT: BEACH BLAST![/b][/u]

Season 8 of Rocket Bot Royale brings with it the SECOND new power-up since launch: THE JETPACK! Reach new heights with this new utility power-up! Aim where you want to go, and fire to activate the jetpack, sending you flying through the air.  We've got new Beach-themed tanks, a new Beach level, and the usual minor bug fixes and optimizations. Here's what's new in this update:

[b]JETPACK:
[/b]A new way to get around! Unlocked at Level 18, and costing 2 energy a pop, the JETPACK is here to help you get to those hard to reach places, and FAST! Steal the high ground in an instant to flip the odds in your favour, or use it to extend your life when there's nowhere left to land! 

[b]SEASON PASS:
[/b]Beach themed Season Pass takes you back to the beach! We've added some interesting beach themed cosmetics in the Season Pass this time around, as well as in the Salvage Crates available in the shop. A sandy new Beach level is now in the mix as well. 

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 🛠 Nerfed Nuke splash damage.
• 🏖 New beach level
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes

Hope you enjoy the new update and the new Season! 
p.s.: We're working on a larger update with an exciting new feature, so stay tuned for that as well!

-Team RBR

notes.title: Season 7: Castle Chaos introduces New Powerup: The Whirlwind!
notes.content:
[u][b]SEASON SEVEN: Castle Chaos![/b][/u]

Season 7 of Rocket Bot Royale brings the first new power-up since launch: THE WHIRLWIND. Drop the Whirlwind to redirect all incoming enemy weapons and even blow enemy tanks right off the island!  We've got new tanks, a new theme, and a bunch of tweaks based on player feedback. Here's what's new in this update:

[b]WHIRLWIND:
[/b]A super gusty blast of wind you can use defensively as well as offensively! Unlocked at Level 16, and costing 2 energy, the Whirlwind is a multi-purpose utility that can come in handy in many situations. We're excited to see how you put it to use, and the strats that emerge! 

[b]SEASON PASS:
[/b]Medieval themed Season Pass takes you back to the middle ages! New themed cosmetics in the Season Pass as well as in the Salvage Crates available in the shop. New Castle Themed maps are also in the mix. 

[b]SEASONAL GAME MODE: Red vs Blue Returns!
[/b]Popular demand brings Red vs Blue mode back to the Island! Two massive squads face off against each other. 

[b]OTHER:[/b]
• 🎁 Added Season Tank back into regular Season Pass
• 💎 Increased gem reward for completing Season Pass
• 🙋‍♂️ Friendly indicators in team-based game modes. 
• 👀 Spectating your squad after being eliminated made easier.
• 💥 Reduced damage of main missile.
• 🛠 Slight buff to the Drill. (+20% speed, smaller explosion radius, removed damage falloff).
• 🔟 Power-up slots are now limited to 10 maximum ammo.
• 👷‍♀️ New construction level
• 🤥 Fixed some leaderboard exploits.
• 🪲 Minor tweaks and bug fixes

We have also decided to attach a small price tag to the Steam version of Rocket Bot Royale. The game will remain free on all other platforms(iOS and Android), and is always playable for free on the web here: [url=https://rocketbotroyale.winterpixel.io/]rocketbotroyale.winterpixel.io[/url]. Players who got the game free will not be affected. Our hope is to be able to keep improving RBR at a pace that keeps players engaged and having fun. We appreciate all the love and support we've gotten from our players so far, and we hope to continue to deliver exciting new features and content as the community grows. 

Hope you enjoy the new update and the new Season!
-Team RBR
